description:
Get the paper portfolio's daily value (NAV), market-cap-weighted vs SPY ("cap", the default) or equal-weighted
    vs RSP ("equal"), with both benchmarks on every row. There is one row per resolved trading day. The series stops at
    the newest date by which every book is revealed, because a later value holds positions from books still sealed.
    Use this for portfolio value over time, and get_simulation_trades for the trades behind it.

from_date.description: Earliest date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no lower bound.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: Latest date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no upper bound.
to_date.title: To Date

weighting.description: "cap" for market-cap weights against SPY (the default), or "equal" for equal weights against RSP.
weighting.title: Weighting

name: get_simulation_nav
title: Portfolio value
